intro: Pacify the Centaur is a retaliatory hunting mission issued by Cliffwatcher Longhorn atop Freewind Post. Charged with clearing the threat gathering beneath the canyon spires, Horde adventurers strike deep into the Galak centaur encampments of Splithoof Crag.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I entreat you to hunt these centaur down. They shall feel the wrath of our revenge. Attack the centaur camp to the north of Freewind Post! Let wrath guide your hand!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Come now friend, I know you haven't killed your share yet. Hunt them down, and I shall give you a reward for my gratitude.

clips.title: Completion
paras: For my gratitude, this is for you, friend.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
